## Schema.grammar property

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

The compiler for the connection's dialect, for inspecting or reusing the generated SQL — [Grammar.wrap()](./database.grammar.wrap.md) in particular, to quote an identifier the same way the builder does.

**Signature:**

